content.value: Good SEO starts with meaningful metadata, crawlable structure, and clean URLs. Publishing includes choosing a domain, HTTPS, and stable redirect behavior so users and learners can reliably access your project long-term.

concepts.name: Page title
concepts.description: The title metadata shown in browser tabs, bookmarks, and search results.

concepts.name: Meta description
concepts.description: A short metadata summary that search engines may use when displaying a page result.

concepts.name: Open Graph metadata
concepts.description: Metadata used by social platforms and link previews to display shared pages.

concepts.name: Search indexing
concepts.description: The process by which search engines discover, analyze, and store page information for search results.

concepts.name: Sitemap
concepts.description: A file or page that lists site URLs to help search engines or users understand site structure.

concepts.name: Canonical URL
concepts.description: The preferred URL for a page when similar or duplicate content may exist at multiple addresses.
